summary: Correctly replaces `max(powers.values())` with `sum(powers.values())` so the min_degrees filter checks total degree instead of the largest single-variable power, matching the documented contract `min_degree <= total_degree(monom) <= max_degree`. Minimal, symmetric fix across both commutative and non-commutative branches.

issues.description: No inline comment added clarifying that total degree = sum of powers; would help future readers avoid reintroducing the max() mistake, but not merge-blocking.
